generate_email_validator.description: CodeAgent GENERATE mode: Create an email validation function from description
generate_email_validator.feature_description: Create a function validate_email(email: str) -> bool that validates email addresses. It should check for: 1) Contains exactly one @ symbol, 2) Has valid local part (before @) with alphanumeric and dots, 3) Has valid domain with at least one dot, 4) Returns True if valid, False otherwise.

fix_buggy_divide.description: CodeAgent FIX mode: Fix a buggy division function that doesn't handle edge cases
fix_buggy_divide.setup_note: First manually add a buggy divide() function to math_utils.py, then run this task

generate_json_parser.description: CodeAgent GENERATE mode: Create a safe JSON parser with error handling
generate_json_parser.feature_description: Create a function parse_json_safe(json_string: str) -> dict | None that safely parses JSON strings. It should: 1) Try to parse the JSON string, 2) Return the parsed dict if successful, 3) Return None if parsing fails (catch exceptions), 4) Include proper type hints and docstring.
